units.source_text: 皇太子屡次催促明石女御回宫。

en.t: The Crown Prince repeatedly urged the Akashi Consort to return to the palace.

units.source_text: 紫夫人说：“难怪他如此想念。

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "No wonder he misses her so much.

units.source_text: 况且添了一件喜事，教他怎么不等得心焦呢？”

en.t: And now that there is this happy news as well, how could he help growing impatient as he waits?"

units.source_text: 便悄悄地准备送小皇子母子入宫。

en.t: So they quietly made preparations to send the little prince and his mother back to the palace.

units.source_text: 小皇子的母亲鉴于入宫后乞假归里之不易，颇想乘此机会在娘家再多住几天。

en.t: The little prince's mother knew it would be hard to ask leave to return home after entering the palace, so she very much wanted to take this chance to stay a few more days at her family home.

units.source_text: 她年纪还小，经过此次可怕的生产之后，形容略见消瘦，姿态异常袅娜。

en.t: She was still young, and after this frightening childbirth her face had grown a little thin, making her figure look unusually delicate and graceful.

units.source_text: 明石夫人等都很担心，说道：“还是在这里多休养几天，等到身体康复后再入宫吧。”

en.t: Lady Akashi and the others were all worried and said, "You should rest here a few more days and enter the palace only after your body has recovered."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“脸庞消瘦些，皇太子看了反而更加怜爱呢。”

en.t: Genji said, "If her face is a little thinner, the Crown Prince will only feel even more tender toward her when he sees her."

units.source_text: 紫夫人等回去以后，傍晚人静之时，明石夫人来到女御房中，将明石道人送文件箱来等事告诉了她。

en.t: After Lady Murasaki and the others had gone back, when evening fell and all was quiet, Lady Akashi came to the Consort's room and told her about the document box sent by the Akashi monk and other matters.

units.source_text: 明石夫人说：“在你没有如意称心地当皇后之前，我本想将此箱隐藏起来，暂勿令你启视。

en.t: Lady Akashi said, "Until you had happily become empress as we hoped, I had meant to hide this box and not let you open it for the time being.

units.source_text: 然而世事无常，人命难知，如此办法终觉不能放心。

en.t: But the world is impermanent and human life is uncertain, so in the end I felt I could not be at ease with that plan.

units.source_text: 万一在你未能随心所欲地行事之前，我身有了三长两短，照我的地位，临终时必然不能和你诀别。

en.t: If something were to happen to me before you could act as freely as you wished, then given my position I would surely be unable to bid you farewell at my deathbed.

units.source_text: 因此还不如趁我身体健康之时将这一件琐屑之事告诉了你。

en.t: So it is better for me to tell you this small matter while I am still in good health.

units.source_text: 这封信文字古怪，难于阅读，但也得给你看看。

en.t: The writing in this letter is strange and hard to read, but I must still show it to you.

units.source_text: 这些祈愿文可放在近旁的柜子里，有便时务须一读。

en.t: These prayer texts may be kept in a nearby cabinet, and you must read them whenever you have the chance.

units.source_text: 其中所许的愿，将来必须酬偿。

en.t: The vows made in them must be fulfilled in the future.

units.source_text: 此事不可向疏远之人泄露。

en.t: You must not reveal this matter to anyone outside your close circle.

units.source_text: 你的前程已可确保无忧，故我亦拟出家为尼。

en.t: Your future can now be considered secure and free from worry, so I too intend to take religious vows and become a nun.

units.source_text: 近来此心日益迫切，以致万事局促不安。

en.t: Lately this desire has grown more urgent by the day, leaving me restless and uneasy in everything I do.

units.source_text: 紫夫人的恩惠，你切不可忘记。

en.t: You must never forget Lady Murasaki's kindness.

units.source_text: 我看到她对你深切无比的关怀，但愿她寿年千岁，比我长生得多。

en.t: Seeing her immeasurably deep concern for you, I pray that she may live a thousand years and far longer than I.

units.source_text: 本来是应该由我抚育你的，但我因身份低微，不得不处处谦抑，所以将你让与紫夫人抚育。

en.t: By rights I should have raised you myself, but because my rank was low I had to be humble in every respect, and so I entrusted you to Lady Murasaki to bring up.

units.source_text: 年来我总以为她不过是一个世间普通的义母，却想不到她会如此真心地爱你。

en.t: For years I thought she was merely an ordinary adoptive mother like any other, but I never imagined she would love you with such sincerity.

units.source_text: 今后我可完全放心了。”

en.t: From now on I can be completely at ease."

units.source_text: 此外又讲了许多话。

en.t: Besides this, she said many other things as well.

units.source_text: 明石女御流着眼泪听她讲。

en.t: The Akashi Consort listened to her with tears streaming down her face.

units.source_text: 她在这个至亲的生母面前，也常恪守礼仪，态度十分谦恭。

en.t: Even before this closest of all people, her own birth mother, she always observed proper etiquette and remained very modest in manner.

units.source_text: 明石道人的信，词句艰深，毫无风趣，写在厚实的陆奥纸上，共五六页。

en.t: The Akashi monk's letter was written in difficult, unappealing language on thick Michinoku paper, and it ran to five or six pages.

units.source_text: 纸已陈旧，颜色变黄，但熏香十分浓重。

en.t: The paper was already old and yellowed, but the scent of incense was very strong.

units.source_text: 明石女御读时深为感动，长垂的额发渐渐沾湿了眼泪，那模样甚是娇艳。

en.t: As the Akashi Consort read it, she was deeply moved, and her long, hanging forelocks gradually grew wet with tears, making her look extraordinarily lovely.
